records.text: Candace Owens repeated an online claim that Javier Milei’s full surname is Mileikowsky and said he resembles Benjamin Netanyahu.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Saw some stuff about like really his full last name is Mileikowsky and he looks a little like Bibi Netanyahu.

verification.notes: Argentina’s official presidency page and Milei’s birth record identify him as Javier Gerardo Milei. The viral “Mileikowsky” surname claim is false. A subjective resemblance to Netanyahu is not a factual basis for the surname assertion.

sources.title: American Horror Story: Charlie Kirk’s “Shining” Disciples. | Candace Ep 288
sources.relevance: Primary episode evidence for the statement wording and speaker attribution.

sources.title: Presidencia de la Nación — Javier Gerardo Milei
sources.relevance: Official Argentine government page gives the president’s name as Javier Gerardo Milei.

sources.title: No, Javier Milei no se apellidaba originalmente Mileikowsky
sources.relevance: Fact-check cites Milei’s birth certificate and official records refuting the surname rumor.
